description: This file defines the AdmonitionRenderer class, which implements rendering logic for admonition blocks in Markdown using the League CommonMark library. It creates HTML output for admonition blocks with optional titles and children content.

classes.name: AdmonitionRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering admonition blocks in Markdown to HTML, implementing the NodeRendererInterface.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an admonition node into an HTML element, including optional title and children content.
